DJIA Market Happenings For Tuesday, November 6, 6th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Coca Cola (KO) and McDonald’s (MCD). down -27 points.
Monday the Dow was up +190.87 (+0.76%) at 25,461.70.
 +3.00%.
There were 25 Dow stocks up Monday.
The Dow stock winners Monday were led by IBM (IBM) +3.80%, Chevron (CVX) +3.67% and McDonald’s (MCD) +2.06%.
The Dow stock losers Monday were led by Apple (AAPL) -2.84%, Goldman Sachs (GS) -0.42% and Exxon Mobil (XOM) -0.38%.
It is so wonderful, Voting Day has arrived and the political ads will soon be gone!
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended mostly higher.
